content: Nix manual IFD section (HIGH): passing an expression that evaluates to a (derivation-produced) store path to import/readFile/readFileType/readDir/pathExists/filterSource/path/hashFile = Import From Derivation; pauses eval, realises the derivation SEQUENTIALLY (evaluator is single-threaded), much slower than parallel realisation; allow-import-from-derivation=false disables and guarantees eval completes before any build. Discourse 60857: readFile of a plain repo path (path type, not derivation output) is NOT IFD and cheap. jade.fyi blog: builtins.fetch* are eval-blocking anti-patterns too; keep hot-path imports to repo paths; one nixpkgs instance + few module-system instances reduce eval cost. PR #5253: nix flake show/search/hydraJobs-check disable IFD. Eval-time blowup with many hosts: nix flake check evaluates all flake outputs incl. every nixosConfiguration (not per-system) but builds only checks.<system>; each nixosSystem/homeConfiguration is a full module-system eval - keep host count and module count lean, use --all-systems only deliberately.
